decisions.reason: The firm visibly committed to this margin analysis tool with its own dedicated page, and having launched it only in 2023, it can still attribute any weak results to market ramp-up, so it persists.
The gas tariff comparison has its own page and is central to the firm's announced regional energy tariff direction, so the sunk investment and public commitment favor keeping it.
The electricity tariff calculator is a core, prominently presented piece of the firm's energy tariff portfolio, making withdrawal hard to justify after the initial investment.
It is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with the electricity and gas calculators, so it is the likeliest to be merged or dropped, but it fits the strategic direction and is cheap to keep.
The regional area definition tool underpins the location-based offerings and is presented on its own page, so the firm's commitment and its link to the other products argue for persistence.
It has lower visibility as a mere mention and overlaps with the gas comparison, but it is consistent with the location-based energy strategy and still early in its life, so it is kept for now.
